pick_word.subtitle: What noise does a turkey make?

question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Which lead did you like the most?

nodes.text: Back at the Chapman house...

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: We're running out of time! What do we do now?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I didn't want it to come to this... But it's time to go to the Wilson side of town!
Back at the Chapman house...

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: We still don't have any turkey! What do we do now?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Let's check out...

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: We still don't have any turkey! What do we do now?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Let's check out...
Back at the Chapman house...

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: We still don't have any turkey! What do we do now?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Let's check out...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: What? That's a terrible thing to say! Our Thanksgiving is going to be great!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: But... You heard what they said! There are no more turkeys left in any of the stores!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Thanksgiving is ruined!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Now listen here, Chip. I know today might not have gotten off to the best start... In fact, it's gotten off to a pretty terrible start!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: But I am making a vow, right here and right now... We `will` have a turkey tonight!
nodes.text_bbcode: But I am making a vow, right here and right now... We [color=#e23b3b][i]will[/i][/color] have a turkey tonight!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: But... But how?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: You just leave that to me.
Fifteen minutes later, in the Chapman living room, Spike has drawn up a plan on a large sheet of paper!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Now look here. It's 5:00. We've still got at least three hours to find a turkey, and I've got three good leads.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I know for a fact that Kenji and Megan usually celebrate Thanksgiving by themselves at the Auto-Shop. If we hit them up, I'm sure they'd be down to share!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Our second option is to check out the farmer's market on the outskirts of town. They usually run late, and they might have something left!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: What's the third lead?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Well... I was hoping it wouldn't come to this... But if we have to, we can go over to the Wilson side of town and look there.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: The twins might know about the stores around here, but I'm sure they haven't checked the ones over there!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: So what are we gonna do first?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I say we...

options.label: Scope out the Wilson side of town.

nodes.text: And on the other side of the car...

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: And, uh, then our grandma's gonna come over, and she's gonna bring pie... And then our Aunt Mabel is gonna come with ice cream...

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Uh, why are you telling us all about your Thanksgiving?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Because it's gonna be the most awesome Thanksgiving ever, that's why!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Who are you?

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Aren't you one of Howard's friends?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I am, yeah, and your brother's a fine guy. Now come on, Chip. We've got to get home if we're going to get our fireworks set up!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: ...Fireworks?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Well, yeah! It's not Thanksgiving unless you've got a fireworks show! Oh, and Chip... Did you remember to feed the ponies?

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: ...Ponies?!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Yeah, you know... Thanksgiving ponies! Give them carrots, ride around on them, make them wear hats with buckles?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: That sounds like the coolest Thanksgiving ever! `I` want a pony in a hat!
nodes.text_bbcode: That sounds like the coolest Thanksgiving ever! [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] want a pony in a hat!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: How come Dad didn't tell us about that? I'm stuffing his turkey with chili peppers!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Come on, Kay! We've got work to do!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: If I had a pony, I'd name him 'Pilgrim'...
The twins walk off.

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: That was awesome, Spike! How'd you make the party sound so cool?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Talking things up is an acquired skill, little bro... I'm sure you'll get the hang of it someday!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: I guess the only way we can make our Thanksgiving good is if we lie about it, huh?
And on the other side of the car...

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: And, uh, then our grandma's gonna come over, and she's gonna bring pie... And then our Aunt Mabel is gonna come with ice cream...

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Uh, why are you telling us all the details of your Thanksgiving?

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Because I'm showing you how happy and normal my family is! My mom's at home, cooking! Wow! Aren't you jealous?

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Uh, no? Isn't that, like, what all moms do?

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Yes! Yes it is! And you know what's not normal? Having your mom work the late shift at 'The Soup Shack'!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Boy, am I sure glad my mom's not doing `that!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Boy, am I sure glad my mom's not doing [color=#e23b3b][i]that![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: What are you talking about?! You're soooo weird!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: And who cares about 'The Soup Shack', anyway? We got banned from that place after The Noodle Incident!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Let's go, Kay! We've got to get these turkeys in the oven!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Bye, weirdo!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: It'll be the best Thanksgiving ever! There'll be cake and mashed potatoes and video games and... And... And ponies!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: ...Ponies?

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Come on, Kay!
Kel grabs Kay and drags her off.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Jeez, Chip... What just happened?

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: I... I just wanted to impress them... And since our Thanksgiving is going to be so lame, I felt like I had to lie!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Wait a minute... Shouldn't the turkey be ready by now?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Well, I put it in the oven at 7:00 a.m., and right now it's 4:00 p.m., so...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Uh oh.
Five minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: You totally burned our turkey! You ruined Thanksgiving!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Look, I'm sorry I messed this up... But it's only 4:00 p.m.! All we have to do is run down to the store and grab a turkey! We'll be okay!
And so, a little while later, in the parking lot of 'The Centerscore Superstore'...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: All right, this should be real easy. We run in, grab a turkey, and... Hey, who's that walking toward us?

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Oh no! It's the twins! What are they doing here?!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Howard's sisters? Hey, is Howard around?

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Shut up! Shut up! Hide!
Chip spins Spike around and shoves him behind a car!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Chip? Is that you?

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: What are you doing here?

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Just... Grocery shopping for my mom.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: We've been shopping too! Our dad took us to every grocery store around here, and they were all out of turkeys... But this store had four left!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: So if you bought one... Then there's three turkeys left in stock!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: No way! We bought all four!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: This way, we get to have four wings each!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: You... Weren't hoping to buy a turkey, were you?

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: No! Not at all! We've, uh, got `five` turkeys at my house! And my mom is home cooking them right now!
nodes.text_bbcode: No! Not at all! We've, uh, got [color=#e23b3b][i]five[/i][/color] turkeys at my house! And my mom is home cooking them right now!

nodes.text: Meanwhile, behind a car... Spike is eavesdropping!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Aw man, the kid is dying out there! Should I help him?

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: ...You think so?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Sure! We've celebrated holidays without Mom before, haven't we? Remember when Aunt Mabel got sick, and Mom had to go to the hospital on Christmas?

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Oh yeah! That was the best Christmas ever! You dressed up like Santa, and your fake beard caught on the fire!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Well, uh, I don't know if that was the fun part...

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: You ran around the whole neighborhood screaming! The guy next door had to blast you with his fire extinguisher!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Look, in my defense, it could have happened to anyone...

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: You were trying to juggle flaming bowling pins while skateboarding! You called yourself 'The World's Coolest Santa'!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Yeah, well, I can't promise you anything as awesome as the sight of me running around with my face on fire...

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Dressed as Santa!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: ...But I can promise you a great evening of bad TV, staying up late, and shoving your face full of turkey!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: ...Really? Anything?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Sure!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Well, then... Let's go to 'The Soup Shack' and bug Mom 'til she comes home!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Well, uh... Anything but that.

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Well, then, let's keep prank-calling 'The Soup Shack' 'til Mom `has` to come home!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, then, let's keep prank-calling 'The Soup Shack' 'til Mom [color=#e23b3b][i]has[/i][/color] to come home!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Well, uh, no, we can't do that either...

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Well, then let's go get some powdered soap and put it in the soup mix, so everyone at the restaurant gets sick!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: What? No! Where would you even get that idea?!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Have you been hanging out with Howard's sisters again?

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Well... Can I at least stay up late and eat as much turkey as I want?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: You know what? I'm pretty sure we can make that happen!
Chip scrambles forward, searching blindly in the dark...
And finds the grate covering the exit!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Yes! I found it! Let's just pry this thing open...

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Whoa!
Chip tumbles down through the grate...
And lands in the pitch-black Auto-Shop!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Okay, okay, that was the hard part... Now I just have to find a light switch!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Look, you don't have to worry about us. Kenji and I might not have much...

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: But we have each other. And that's all the family we need.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Heh. You see this, guys? It turns out all girls are total softies at heart!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Why, you... That does it! I'm never being nice to you again!
Megan grabs a tire iron off a nearby table!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Say that again! Call me a softie again!
Megan takes off, chasing Kenji around the room!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Run for your lives! Save yourselves!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Come on, Chip. Let's get out of here.
A few minutes later, Spike and Chip head home.

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Why didn't we stay for mashed potatoes? I bet we could've gotten some once that crazy girl calmed down...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Yeah, I know... But did you see the two of them? I know they don't get a lot of time together, and it's pretty clear this means a lot to them.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: It's like Megan said... It's the closest they've got to a family thing. I'm not going to intrude on that.

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: I guess...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I mean, we had a `huge` dinner, didn't we, Chip? Couldn't eat another bite!
nodes.text_bbcode: I mean, we had a [color=#e23b3b][i]huge[/i][/color] dinner, didn't we, Chip? Couldn't eat another bite!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: If I ate another bite, I'd probably explode!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Oh, really? That's funny, I figured you guys came here to mooch...

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: But I guess you two have a real family... You guys got a real Thanksgiving meal...

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Do you want to stick around and hang out?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Sorry, Megan, but we've really got to get going.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: It's cool.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Hey Kenji! Go grab the turkey out of the freezer and get it in the microwave!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: I'm on it!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: ...Turkey? You have a turkey?

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Well, yeah... You didn't think `this` was all our food, did you? Ha!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, yeah... You didn't think [color=#3b78e2][i]this[/i][/color] was all our food, did you? Ha!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: I mean, we're broke... But not having a turkey? That'd be ridiculous!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: ...Yeah. Ridiculous.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Anyway, we're gonna get started. You guys have fun tonight, okay?

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: But... But...
Megan runs off, helping Kenji haul a huge turkey out of the Auto-Shop fridge!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: I feel like there's a lesson here...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Let's just go home.
Suddenly, there's a commotion from the Auto-Shop! The door swings open, and Chip rushes out!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: I did it! I did it! I got the door open!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Way to go, little bro!
Kenji comes rushing back.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: My art project! What did you to do to my art project?!
Spike looks over... And sees an elegant metal structure crushed by the broken vent!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Oh no! I'm so sorry!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: That... That was the last thing Linda and I worked on together...
Kenji shakes his head.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Forget it. It doesn't matter.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: You did it, Spike! You got the door open!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Don't thank me... It was all Chip!
Everyone rushes into the Auto-Shop. Kenji and Megan head over to the fridge.

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Psst! Spike! Are we gonna ask them for turkey now?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Sure! Let's just wait 'til they get it out...
Kenji and Megan open the fridge... And take out three tiny plastic containers!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Aw man! That's all they've got?! That's barely enough food for the two of them!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I can't take any of that...

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Is that... All?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Shh! Let's just get out of here!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Hey, Spike! You heading out?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Uh, yeah, you know, places to go, people to see...

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Well, at least take some mashed potatoes for the road. We owe you that much.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: No, really, it's okay... We're, uh, we're good...

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Something wrong with our mashed potatoes?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: No! It's just that...

options.label: You guys don't have much food...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I mean, where were you guys during the FLEX-Games? It would've been nice if you could've come to cheer!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: We didn't come to the FLEX-Games because you never invited us! We only found out you were in them the day after!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Wait... Really?

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Yes!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Okay, okay, maybe I haven't been the best friend... If you wanna know the truth, I haven't had time to do much of anything besides skate...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: But you can't get mad at me because Linda picked Howard! That's unfair, and you know it.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Whatever, Spike. Just don't come around trying to act like you really care about Kenji, okay?
For one moment, Megan looks like she's about to punch Spike...
And then she turns away!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: You're right. He'd never want me getting on your case on his behalf... And you know, I don't think `he's` even really mad at you.
nodes.text_bbcode: You're right. He'd never want me getting on your case on his behalf... And you know, I don't think [color=#3b78e2][i]he's[/i][/color] even really mad at you.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: It's just... I've never seen him like this! At first, I thought it was funny... But now I'm really worried!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: I got so used to the idea of him being this tough, jaded guy, I never thought I'd have to deal with him being heartbroken!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: He's a tough guy, Megan. I'm sure he'll bounce back soon enough.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: I sure hope so...
Chip scrambles forward, groping blindly in the dark...

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: That grate has got to be... Somewhere around here...
Suddenly, the whole vent lurches downward and snaps off from its supports!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Aaaaaaaaaagh!
The vent comes crashing down! Chip tumbles out of it onto the floor of the Auto-Shop and smashes into something in the darkness!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Huff... Huff... I guess I'm... Okay...

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: I hope I didn't break anything important... But I guess I should just be happy I made it at all!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Now where the heck is a light switch?
Spike and Chip head down to Centerscore High, where Kenji and Megan are furiously tinkering with the Auto-Shop door.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Yo, K! What's up?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Spike! What're you doing here? Shouldn't you be celebrating Thanksgiving with your Mom?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Long story. What're you two up to?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Well, you know how Megan and I like to celebrate Thanksgiving together in the Auto-Shop, right?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Yeah...

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: This year, some moron bought new locks for the door!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: All our food is in the Auto-Shop fridge...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: And there's no other way in?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Well, we managed to pry open that air vent over the door... But Megan and I are too big to fit!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: ...What about me? I'll crawl through it!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: You will?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: He will?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Uh, can you guys give us a sec?
Spike kneels down and whispers to Chip.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: What do you think you're doing?

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: I can do this, Spike! And if we help them get in, I bet they'd share their turkey with us!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I dunno... What if you get hurt?

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Don't worry about it! I'll be fine! I've totally done this before!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: You have?

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Well, I saw a movie where someone did it, and that's practically the same thing! I promise I'll be fine!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Heh... You really are my little brother, aren't you? All right, kid. Let's do this!
A minute later... Chip has been hoisted up into the vent!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: It sure is... Dark in here...

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Whoa! This vent isn't very stable! I better find the grate leading to the Auto-Shop... And fast!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Let's see... A cow goes 'moo'... A dog goes 'woof woof'...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Man, I feel like I'm back in kindergarten!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Wait... Wait... I got it!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Gobble gobble! Gobble gobble!
The turkey glances up...
Then happily wanders towards Spike!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Just a little closer... A little closer... And...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Gotcha!
Spike triumphantly grabs the turkey!

nodes.speaker: Voice
nodes.text: Hey! What do you think you're doing?

nodes.speaker: Moondog
nodes.text: Oh... I don't think we really have anything like that... But do you want to just hang out?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Look, Moondog, any other day, I'd stick around... But it's pretty important that the two of us get some real Thanksgiving food, you know?

nodes.speaker: Moondog
nodes.text: Well, if you gotta go, you gotta go. I get that.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: See you later, Moondog. I'll swing by some time, okay?

nodes.speaker: Moondog
nodes.text: Sure, man! If you change your mind, we'll still be here!
Spike quickly douses the slice in hot sauce!

nodes.speaker: Patchouli
nodes.text: Oh, shoot! That loaf wasn't one of the better ones!

nodes.speaker: Patchouli
nodes.text: I'll eat that one and get you another one!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Uh, wait, maybe you don't want to...
Before Spike can react, Patchouli pops the slice into her mouth!

nodes.speaker: Patchouli
nodes.text: What the...? This... This tastes funny...

nodes.speaker: Moondog
nodes.text: You don't like my lentil-loaf?

nodes.speaker: Patchouli
nodes.text: It doesn't taste right... It tastes like... High fructose corn syrup... Artificial preservatives...

nodes.speaker: Patchouli
nodes.text: Xanthan gum... Food coloring... And...

nodes.speaker: Patchouli
nodes.text: Anchovies?!

nodes.speaker: Moondog
nodes.text: I didn't put any of those in! Someone must be trying to poison you... Again!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Actually, I... Uh... Might have put some hot sauce on it...

nodes.speaker: Patchouli
nodes.text: Oh, blech! Yuck! I can taste all the chemicals! They taste like burning! Buuuuuuurning!
Patchouli runs off.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Sorry, Moondog. I guess lentil-loaf is just a little too out there for me.

nodes.speaker: Moondog
nodes.text: Well, is there any food here that you even want?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I guess I was kind of hoping for something more... Traditional...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Well... I guess I ought to be polite!
Spike pops the loaf in his mouth!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Hey, that's... That's pretty good! And I don't usually like lentils!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: I don't even know what a lentil is!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: It's a type of forest mushroom. Don't worry about it.

nodes.speaker: Moondog
nodes.text: You like my lentil-loaf, eh? It's a family recipe, first discovered by my ancestor, the vegetarian pilgrim Moonzekial P. Dogmitias...

nodes.speaker: Patchouli
nodes.text: How's Tofurkey doing?

nodes.speaker: Moondog
nodes.text: She's doing that thing where she bites me if I try to put her in the pen... Do you want to go check on her for me?

nodes.speaker: Patchouli
nodes.text: Silly boy! You've just got to be gentle with her!
Patchouli runs off.

nodes.speaker: Moondog
nodes.text: So do you want anything else to eat? Organic bean stew? Spicy pepper wrap? Tofu-stuffed-tofu?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Well, I'm sure it's all good... But I think we were looking for something more traditional...

nodes.speaker: Patchouli
nodes.text: So, do you guys want anything to eat? We've got more than enough food!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Sure, yeah, we'd love to have some!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Do you have any biscuits?

nodes.speaker: Patchouli
nodes.text: The modern wheat industry kills hundreds of thousands of animals a year in threshers! Absolutely not!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Right, right. Threshers. Sure hate those threshers. How about some corn? Do you have any corn?

nodes.speaker: Patchouli
nodes.text: The corn industry is a monstrous multinational conglomerate determined to stuff us full of chemicals!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Oh, right. How could I forget that? Well, do you guys have any pie?

nodes.speaker: Patchouli
nodes.text: Are you kidding? No way!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Pie is a symbol of American cultural dominance?

nodes.speaker: Patchouli
nodes.text: No, I just don't really like pie. We do have this great lentil-loaf! It's just like a meatloaf but with lentils!

nodes.speaker: Patchouli
nodes.text: Here! Try some!
Patchouli hands Spike a tray with a slice of lentil-loaf and turns back to the table.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Oh man, this thing looks blander than an episode of 'Most People Like Raymondo'!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Luckily, I always carry a little bottle of hot sauce for good luck... But should I use it?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Well, it's kind of a long story... But basically, we were out here trying to find a turkey...

nodes.speaker: Patchouli
nodes.text: Oh! You wanted to adopt one, like we did with Tofurkey!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Well, uh, no, not quite...

nodes.speaker: Patchouli
nodes.text: Oh... You were trying to find one that was malnourished and make sure it got fed!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Not exactly that either...

nodes.speaker: Patchouli
nodes.text: You were trying to make sure no animal testing had been done on turkeys in the area?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Actually, we were kind of hoping to... Erm... Eat it.

nodes.speaker: Patchouli
nodes.text: What?! Are you kidding? You'd eat a poor, defenseless, little turkey?

nodes.speaker: Patchouli
nodes.text: What's next, Spike? Eating kittens? Babies? Kitten babies?!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Did he say 'eat it'? Because he meant 'meet it'! I'd never seen a live turkey before, and Spike wanted to introduce me!

nodes.speaker: Patchouli
nodes.text: Well... I guess that is better... But wild turkeys can be very dangerous if you don't approach them correctly! You really ought to be more careful!
Patchouli turns and starts fussing with the table.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: 'Meet it'? What was that?!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Like you were doing so great! I'm 9 years old, and I know better than to admit to a girl that I'm trying to eat her pet turkey!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Well, you see, we were volunteering with this organization that helps abandoned turkeys find good homes...

nodes.speaker: Patchouli
nodes.text: You work for G.O.B.B.L.E.?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Gobble?

nodes.speaker: Patchouli
nodes.text: Yeah, you know... 'Get Orphaned Birds Better Lives Everyday'? The nation's largest turkey rescue organization?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Oh, uh, yes! Absolutely! That's who we work for!

nodes.speaker: Patchouli
nodes.text: That's so great! The world needs more people like you, Spike and Smaller Spike!
Patchouli turns and starts fussing with the table.

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: I feel kind of bad lying to her...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Not as bad as you'd feel if she found out we tried to murder her pet!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Okay, okay... I can do this... I can do this...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Meow! Woof! Hisssss! Yip yip! Hootey-hoo!
The turkey stares at Spike impassively.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Uh... Guten tag?
The turkey rears up in anger and dives at Spike!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Aaaaaa! Aiiiiieeee! Help me! Killer turkey! Killer turkey!

nodes.speaker: Voice
nodes.text: Hey! What's going on around here?
Spike and Chip take the bus down to the Farmer's Market...
And find it totally deserted!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Where... Where is everyone? Did the apocalypse happen?!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Relax... I'll figure it out! Look! Here's a sign!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: 'Note to all: The Farmer's Market is closed for Thanksgiving so the farmers can spend time with their emotionally distant yet ultimately lovable families!'

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: I wish our family was ultimately lovable...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Hey! Our family was lovable from the start! And quit worrying... We'll get that turkey!
Suddenly, there's a rustling from the bushes nearby!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Is that... What I think it is?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Unless we're both going crazy and hallucinating... Yes, Chip, that is a turkey!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: `Our` turkey! Block the road so it can't run out! I'll chase it down!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Our[/i][/color] turkey! Block the road so it can't run out! I'll chase it down!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Do you even know how to cook a wild turkey?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: That's what the Internet is for, little bro! Now go block the road, quick!
Spike creeps towards the turkey through the underbrush...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Here, turkey, turkey... Here turkey, turkey...
The turkey stares at Spike blankly, then hops a few feet away!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Shoot! This isn't working! I'll need to lure it over to me...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Cheep che-reep! Cheep che-reep! Tweet tweet tweet!
The turkey cocks its head in confusion!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Dang! I forgot what noise a turkey makes!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Just calm down, Spike. Take a deep breath... And remember what animals make what sounds!

rounds.subtitle: What noise does a turkey make?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Man... I really thought we were gonna have that turkey...

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Hey, Spike? Can we call a cab to take us home? I don't really want to walk back through there...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I don't know, Chip. It's pretty expensive, and I've been trying to save money...
A horrifying scream rings out in the distance.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Did I say 'save money'? Because I meant spend money! Let's call that cab!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: We're not that different, and there's got to be enough for three people...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Just because we're from opposite sides of town doesn't mean we can't be nice to each other for just one day...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Come on. Look at my brother. I get why you'd hate me, but what's he done to deserve this?

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: That's... That's your best tactic? Try to manipulate me with a little kid?

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: I'm nine and a half! That makes me almost a tween which is almost a teenager which is almost an adult!

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: Heh... I'll admit he's got spunk.

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: All right, fine. Let's split the turkey. But you've got to swear never to tell anyone about this!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Heh! Not a problem!
The three of them rush into the cafeteria...
Where Skazz is happily polishing off what's left of the turkey!

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: How?!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Why?!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Oh hey, guys! What're you doing here?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: `We're` here to eat the turkey you just wolfed down! What are you doing here? Don't tell me you don't have a family either!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]We're[/i][/color] here to eat the turkey you just wolfed down! What are you doing here? Don't tell me you don't have a family either!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Oh, no, I've got a huge family! They just don't like me!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Hey, wait a minute... You're not supposed to be here! And Stiletto! Why are you with them? What's going on?
Stiletto cracks her knuckles.

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: Get out of here, you two. I've got to handle this.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Sure thing!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: See what? What's going? What's happening? Why is it happening? Am I having another one of my weird dreams?

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: No, no, I'm wearing pants, so it can't be a dream...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Come on, Chip. Let's get out of here before it gets any weirder!

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: Oh really? And what exactly could you offer me?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Uh... Well... We could let you loot the Centerscore cafeteria?

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: Oh, I see how it is! You're trying to swindle me! You honestly think I'm dumb enough to fall for that?

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: If there was any good food in the Centerscore cafeteria, why would you two even be here?!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Hmm... I guess I didn't think that one through...

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: Here, I've got a deal for you. How about I let you walk out of here unscathed, and in return, you never bother me again? Do we have a deal?

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: We do! We do!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: ...We have a deal.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Wait, what?

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Did your family burn their turkey too?

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: I don't have a family, not any more. I got emancipated when I was 16 and never looked back.

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: You got your head cut off?!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: That's 'decapitated'. Emancipated means that she gets treated as an adult, and her parents don't have any legal control over her.

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: What?! That's awesome! I want to get empantstinated!

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: Oh really? You want to spend Thanksgiving alone every year? You want to eat cold pizza for dinner because you can't afford any turkey?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: That's why you're here, huh? You're just trying to have a regular Thanksgiving, same as us...

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: It doesn't matter. That's still a Wilson High turkey, and you're still on Wilson High turf!

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: I'm not gonna beat you up... But I'm not letting you walk out with it either!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Come on. It doesn't have to go down like this! Why don't we...

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: Oh really? And what's that? Stealing some supplies? Vandalizing some property? Kidnapping our mascot?!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Actually, no. The only thing we're after is some leftover turkey, okay?

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: ...What? What are you talking about?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Our Thanksgiving plans didn't go so well, and it's really important to me that Chip and I have a real holiday together.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: We heard a rumor there was a turkey here... So we came. That's it. That's the sad truth.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Well? You gonna kick us out now?

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: If it were any other day, yeah... But it's Thanksgiving, and I can't be mad at you for trying to look out for your brother.

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: Even if you are a stupid Centerscore loser!

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: Besides, the truth is... I'm here for that turkey too.

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: Really? We're doing this? `Really?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Really? We're doing this? [color=#3b78e2][i]Really?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: You better believe it! It's two on one, I fight dirty, and Chip's got one mean bite!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Grrrr! I bite so bad, I got sent home from kindergarten... Twice!
Stiletto sighs, reaches into her pocket, takes out a quarter...
And flicks it right into Spike's forehead!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Aaaaaaaaagh! Ow! That really hurt!

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: I did that with two fingers...

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: Imagine what I could do with two fists!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: We surrender!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Yeah, seriously... Just don't flick any more quarters!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Sorry, Chip. I guess we're not getting that turkey here after all...

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: Turkey? You're here for the turkey?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Not that it's any of your business, but yeah, we are. Our Thanksgiving plans crashed and burned, and I'm trying to make up for it, okay?

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: If that's... If that's why you're really here... Then I guess I understand.

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: The truth is... I'm here for that turkey too!
A little while later, Spike and Chip head to the border of the Wilson side of town...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Now remember, Chip, you need to stay close. We won't be on the nice, safe side of town... We'll be on Wilson turf.

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: What's so bad about the Wilson side of town, anyway?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Lately, there have been a lot of weird rumors going around about this place... Weird, weird rumors...

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Hello, gentlemen.

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Aaaaaaagh! A pirate! Hide our plunder!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Relax, Chip, it's just this guy from my school! What's up, Andy?

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: I have a proposition for the two of you. I know all about your mission: find a turkey, save Thanksgiving, figure out the truth behind your uncle's disappearance...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: What was that last one?

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: No? Not you? Hmm, I must have my files mixed up. Well, the first two are right, aren't they?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: ...Sure?

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Well, then. I know of a place on the Wilson side that has one pristine frozen turkey, just waiting to be taken.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: You do?

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: As it turns out, I need to get deep into Wilson turf as well, not far from where you want to go.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Lately though, it hasn't been safe to wander here alone... Especially this late in the day.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: So we walk with you to your destination, and then you point us in the direction of ours?

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Exactly. Do we have a deal?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Well...

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: We do! We do!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I guess we do!
A little while later, Spike, Chip, and Andy make their way through the Wilson side of town...

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Aaaaaah! What was that?!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: What? What is it? What did you see?

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: I saw something moving around, creeping through the shadows!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: What did it look like?

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Like a creepy thing that creeps around, being all creepy!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Come on, Chip, you're just seeing things! This is like the time you thought there Bigfoot was in the kitchen, but it was just Aunt Mabel!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: She has `enormous` feet, okay?! No one should have feet that big!
nodes.text_bbcode: She has [color=#e23b3b][i]enormous[/i][/color] feet, okay?! No one should have feet that big!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: I hate to admit it, but Chip wasn't imagining things. There is something out there... And it's watching us.

nodes.speaker: Voice
nodes.text: doooooooooom!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: What was that?! Did you guys hear that?!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: It's a werewolf! It's a zombie! It's Aunt Mabel!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Listen to me, both of you! You cannot give in to your fears! Stay strong and brave, and we'll be fine!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: But...

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Strong and brave! Now! Do it!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: We do not fear you, understand?!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: You wanna fight? Huh? Bring it on! I'll take you down, any day!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Raaaaar! I'm tough and mean! I'm so tough, on Halloween, the Boogeyman dresses up as `me!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Raaaaar! I'm tough and mean! I'm so tough, on Halloween, the Boogeyman dresses up as [color=#e23b3b][i]me![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Heh. Good line, Chip.

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Thanks!
There's a rustling in the nearby trees...
And then it fades, leaving only the distant wail of the wind.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: We did it! Awesome job, both of you! That could've gotten real bad!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Who was that?

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Trust me on this one, Spike... You really don't want to know. Now follow me! Our destination is close!
The three of them run off...
And a ragged, pale figure emerges from the bushes...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Doom
nodes.text: not... the one... not yet...
Meanwhile, Andy leads the group down a few streets... To the Wilson High parking lot!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: The turkey's at Wilson High?

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Of course! They have one left over from their Thanksgiving lunch that they forgot to cook! It's just sitting in their cafeteria fridge!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Andy, you're a genius!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: This is where we must part ways for now... My own mission calls. Thanks for your help... And good luck saving Thanksgiving!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Waaaaaaaah! Something's gonna get us!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Stay calm, Chip! Stay c... Aaaaaagh! What was that?!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Get it together, both of you!
Suddenly, everything goes silent...

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Is... Is it gone?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Doom
nodes.text: hello... boys...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: AAAAAAAHHHH!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: AAAAAAAHHHH!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Run! Both of you! I'll hold him off!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: But... What about...

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: I'll be fine! Go! Go!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Doom
nodes.text: she will... not be... yours...

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: That is `NOT` your decision to make!
nodes.text_bbcode: That is [color=#e23b3b][i]NOT[/i][/color] your decision to make!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Doom
nodes.text: Doooooooom!!!
Nearby... Spike and Chip sprint through the streets... And come to the parking lot of Wilson High!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Huff... Huff... Is Pirateman going to be... Okay?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: He's a tough kid. He can take care of himself!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: But we still don't know where to go for the turkey...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: No... No, we...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Wait a minute! This is it! This is where we were supposed to go!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Wilson High?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: They always get way bigger lunches than we do! They must have leftover turkey in their cafeteria freezer!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: I don't know about this... Isn't it stealing?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: It's stealing `from Wilson`, dude! That's like killing a zombie! No judge in the land would convict you!
nodes.text_bbcode: It's stealing [color=#e23b3b][i]from Wilson[/i][/color], dude! That's like killing a zombie! No judge in the land would convict you!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Well... Okay!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Man, I haven't been here in ages! They've really touched this place up since it got flooded...

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: It got flooded?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Long story. Anyway, the cafeteria should be coming up... Right...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Here! It's just through this door!

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: What do you two think you're doing?!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Aaaaah! Who are you?
Spike lunges in front of Chip!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: She's a Wilson High student... One of the toughest!

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: Heh, that's right...

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: Now give me one good reason I shouldn't throw both of you out the nearest window!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Uh... You shouldn't do that because...

options.label: You can't take both of us!

nodes.text: Imagine if the Pilgrims had gotten really, really close to America but never landed. That would've been lame, huh?
So is `almost` getting a perfect game! Give it another shot and you might just see how our other characters are spending their Thanksgivings!
nodes.text_bbcode: So is [b]almost[/b] getting a perfect game! Give it another shot and you might just see how our other characters are spending their Thanksgivings!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: You okay with this, Chip?

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Are you kidding? Your friends are so cool! And this way, we get to have a big dinner after all!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I guess that's kind of true... In a way, maybe we did learn a lesson about...

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Less talking! More eating! Go go go!
Spike turns to walk away when suddenly, the doorbell rings again!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Um... Hello?

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Is Chip home?

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: It's the twins! What are they doing here?!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: You know what, little bro? I think you can handle this one!
Spike rushes off!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Uh... Um... Come in!
Kay and Kel rush in... Holding a fully cooked turkey!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Our dad yelled at us because we cooked too many turkeys...

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: So we decided to give them out! Do you want one?

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Are you kidding? Absolutely! I want that more than anything!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: I mean, uh, yeah, it's cool. We'll take it.
There's a commotion from the kitchen, where Spike and his friends are laughing!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Whoa! You've `still` got friends over? Our party ended like an hour ago!
nodes.text_bbcode: Whoa! You've [color=#3b78e2][i]still[/i][/color] got friends over? Our party ended like an hour ago!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: I told you, Kay! Spike and Chip are `so` cool!
nodes.text_bbcode: I told you, Kay! Spike and Chip are [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] cool!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Well, uh... Do you want to come in and hang for a little bit?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Sure! That sounds like fun!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: If you've got pie, we're eating it!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Man, I still wish Mom was here... But I'll make sure there's plenty of food left over for her!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Who knows... This might turn out to be the best Thanksgiving ever!
Wow! Talk about turning things around! You gave Spike and Chip a great night and maybe even helped them learn something in the process!
Have a happy Thanksgiving, and we'll see you in another episode of 'Surviving High School'!
Moondog steps in holding a pumpkin pie!

nodes.speaker: Moondog
nodes.text: Dude, you found Tofurkey when she got lost! How could I `not` come over with pie?
nodes.text_bbcode: Dude, you found Tofurkey when she got lost! How could I [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] come over with pie?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Thanks! Why don't you go put the food out on the back deck... It's nice out there!
Moondog heads off to put the pie down!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Yeah, it was kind of an adventure, huh? When we were in Wilson, man, I thought we were done for!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: How about when I crawled through the vent? That was pretty cool, wasn't it?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Are you kidding? It was awesome!
Suddenly, the doorbell rings!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Huh? Come in! The door's open!
The door opens... And reveals a group of Spike's friends!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Huh? What are you guys doing here?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Do you see any friends here, Chip? Do you see any family? We're all alone, and we've got to make do...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: That means getting you a turkey, whether you want it or not!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Okay! Sorry! Geez!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: You wait here... I just had a great idea!
Fifteen minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: You ready for this, Chip? Because I have one heck of a turkey for you!
Spike comes out of the kitchen carrying...

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: That's not a turkey at all! That's a bunch of sliced turkey sandwich meat taped to a cardboard cutout of a turkey!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: What are you talking about? This is `totally` a turkey! Look at the head!
nodes.text_bbcode: What are you talking about? This is [color=#e23b3b][i]totally[/i][/color] a turkey! Look at the head!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: That's the head of a stuffed penguin! Wait a minute... Is that...

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Admiral Flappers! Nooooooooooooo! What did Spike do to you?!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Now, now, you know the expression, Chip! It's not nice to look a gift turkey in the waddle!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: I hate you! You're the worst brother ever! I'm calling Mom!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Waaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Geez, what's his problem? It's a perfectly good turkey!
Spike takes a big bite of cardboard...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Could use a little more salt though...
Yikes! Spike's so desperate, he's become delusional! There's no way you wanted that!
Maybe if he'd made more friends, this wouldn't have happened! Try again! We know you can fix this Thanksgiving disaster!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: You know what? I think... I think it's okay!

nodes.speaker: Spike

nodes.speaker: Lucretia
nodes.text: But... We're out of leads!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Out of leads? Ha! We're just getting started!
Later that night, Kay and Kel are clearing their table when...
Spike and Chip come crashing in through the window wearing ski-masks!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: This is a robbery! Give us the turkey, and no one gets hurt!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Do we really have to do this, Spike? I don't feel good about it...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I thought I told you not to use my real name! Now stick to the script!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Ahem, ahem. We are professional robbers. Don't be a hero, just give us the turkey.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Burglars are invading the house, Kay! I `told` you this would happen! You know what to do!
nodes.text_bbcode: Burglars are invading the house, Kay! I [color=#3b78e2][i]told[/i][/color] you this would happen! You know what to do!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: I'm on it!
Kay reaches behind a shelf and pulls on a hidden rope...
The lights go out...

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Ow!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: My feet!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: What was that?!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Stop grabbing me!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Hey! Not the hair!
The lights flash back on! Chip and Spike are on the floor back to back, tied up with a thick rope!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Oh no! They took our masks off!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Chip!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Bigger Chip!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: ...Well, this is awkward.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: You guys are burglars! Turkey burglars! That's the worst kind of burglar!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: I bet you guys didn't even have a party tonight! You were just trying to lure us in to steal our turkeys!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: No! Wait! It's not like that, honest!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: You're the worst boy in the world, Chip! I can't believe we thought you were cool!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: You... You did?

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Come on, Kay! Let's go call the police! These losers are going to jail! Turkey-burglar jail!

nodes.speaker: Kay

nodes.speaker: Chip

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: I guess we're not having a turkey after all...

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Are you kidding? I promised you a turkey, and you're getting a turkey!
Meanwhile, outside...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Did you just hear a crash?

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Nope... But my hearing's been a little off ever since the accident with the welding torch.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Hey, Kenji! Did you hear anything?
Kenji walks off.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Hey, what's the deal with Kenji? Why's he acting so mopey?

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: ...It's nothing. He's just, uh, tired.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Come on, Megan. I can tell when something's wrong.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: And what makes you so nosy?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: He's my friend... I want to make sure he's okay!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Well, if you're such a good friend of Kenji's, maybe you can explain why you helped your buddy Howard steal his girl?!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Wh... What?! Linda was Kenji's girl?

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Yeah, she was... Until you helped Howard perform that stupid song!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Look, I had no idea Kenji and Linda had something going on... Last I heard, he just helped her get back that float!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Well, maybe if you'd actually been around the last couple of months, you'd know what's going on! What kind of a friend are you?!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Hey! First off, I've been really busy lately! And second...

options.label: It's not like you showed an interest in my life!
If Kenji's mad, he should talk to me himself!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Uh, well, the thing is, I...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Moondog?! Is that you?

nodes.speaker: Moondog
nodes.text: Yeah, man, it's me... Now what are you doing with Tofurkey?!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Tofurkey?

nodes.speaker: Moondog
nodes.text: Yeah! Tofurkey! My pet turkey! Why're you holding onto her?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Oh, I, uh... I saw it wandering around, lost and scared! I thought I'd, uh, help it get home!

nodes.speaker: Moondog
nodes.text: Oh, for real? That's awesome! Thanks, man!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Yeah, uh, no problem. Here you go.
The turkey runs over to Moondog!

nodes.speaker: Moondog
nodes.text: Aw, there you are, Tofurkey! Good girl! Good girl!

nodes.speaker: Moondog
nodes.text: Yeah! My pet turkey! Why're you grappling with her, man?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Oh, I, uh, um, well, see, the thing is, uh, I, hrm. I guess I'm not really going to talk my way out of this one, am I?
The turkey runs over and cowers behind Moondog's legs. Spike stands up.

nodes.speaker: Moondog
nodes.text: It's okay, girl. He's not gonna hurt you anymore!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I'm sorry, man. I had no idea she was yours.

nodes.speaker: Moondog
nodes.text: Whatever, it's okay... I guess.

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Hey, Spike! I got bored waiting! Did you catch...

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: ...The turkey?

nodes.speaker: Moondog
nodes.text: Whoa, are you Spike's little bro? I've heard a lot about you!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: You have?

nodes.speaker: Moondog
nodes.text: Yeah! Didn't you once dress up as a Sloanas Brother for Halloween?

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Spike told people about that?!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Dude, you were hilarious! How could I not?

nodes.speaker: Moondog
nodes.text: What are you guys doing out here, anyway? Shouldn't you be having your Thanksgiving dinner?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Actually, our Thanksgiving didn't work out quite the way we wanted...

nodes.speaker: Moondog
nodes.text: Well look, my family farm is just up the road. Why don't you guys swing by and grab something to eat? I'm sure we'll have plenty to share!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Uh, sure... I guess we can hang out for a bit...

nodes.speaker: Moondog
nodes.text: Great! Follow me!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: What? Why are we going to his house?!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Dude, he caught me man-handling his turkey! This is the least I can do!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Heh... Now there's something I never thought I'd say...
Spike and Chip follow Moondog...
And come to a lovely cottage in the woods! A nice picnic table is set up underneath a canopy!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Whoa, this place is great!

nodes.speaker: Moondog
nodes.text: Yeah, my uncle Sparklefeet owns it... Since my parents are volunteering in South America, he let me and Patchouli borrow it for Thanksgiving!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: When did you get back into town, anyway? I thought you were at some organic co-op in Oregon...

nodes.speaker: Moondog
nodes.text: I was, but you know how those things always go, man. One minute you're all sitting around enjoying soy lattes...

nodes.speaker: Moondog
nodes.text: The next, you're running frantically from an Animal Testing lab with a furious chimpanzee wrapped around your neck!

nodes.speaker: Patchouli
nodes.text: Moondog? Who's here?

nodes.speaker: Patchouli
nodes.text: Oh! Spike! Smaller Spike! Hey there!

nodes.speaker: Moondog
nodes.text: They're gonna be grabbing a bite to eat with us! Why don't you hang out with them? I've got to go put Tofurkey back in her pen!
Moondog runs off.

nodes.speaker: Patchouli
nodes.text: Hey, guys. So what're you doing all the way out here?

nodes.text: Man... How do I play this?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Yo, K! What's up?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Spike! What're you doing here? Shouldn't you be celebrating Thanksgiving with your Mom?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Long story. What're you two up to?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Well, you know how Megan and I like to celebrate Thanksgiving together in the Auto-Shop, right?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Yeah...

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: This year, some moron bought new locks for the door!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: All our food is in the Auto-Shop fridge...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: And there's no other way in?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Well, we managed to pry open that air vent over the door... But Megan and I are too big to fit!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: ...What about me? I'll crawl through it!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: You will?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: He will?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Uh, can you guys give us a sec?
Spike kneels down and whispers to Chip.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: What do you think you're doing?

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: I can do this, Spike! And if we help them get in, I bet they'd share their turkey with us!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I dunno... What if you get hurt?

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Don't worry about it! I'll be fine! I've totally done this before!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: You have?

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Well, I saw a movie where someone did it, and that's practically the same thing! I promise I'll be fine!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Heh... You really are my little brother, aren't you? All right, kid. Let's do this!
A minute later... Chip has been hoisted up into the vent!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: It sure is... Dark in here...

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Whoa! This vent isn't very stable! I better find the grate leading to the Auto-Shop... And fast!
A little while later, Spike and Chip head to the border of the Wilson side of town...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Now remember, Chip, you need to stay close. We won't be on the nice, safe side of town... We'll be on Wilson turf.

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: What's so bad about the Wilson side of town, anyway?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Lately, there have been a lot of weird rumors going around about this place... Weird, weird rumors...

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Hello, gentlemen.

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Aaaaaaagh! A pirate! Hide our plunder!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Relax, Chip, it's just this guy from my school! What's up, Andy?

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: I have a proposition for the two of you. I know all about your mission: find a turkey, save Thanksgiving, figure out the truth behind your uncle's disappearance...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: What was that last one?

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: No? Not you? Hmm, I must have my files mixed up. Well, the first two are right, aren't they?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: ...Sure?

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Well, then. I know of a place on the Wilson side that has one pristine frozen turkey, just waiting to be taken.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: You do?

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: As it turns out, I need to get deep into Wilson turf as well, not far from where you want to go.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Lately though, it hasn't been safe to wander here alone... Especially this late in the day.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: So we walk with you to your destination, and then you point us in the direction of ours?

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Exactly. Do we have a deal?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Well...

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: We do! We do!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I guess we do!
A little while later, Spike, Chip, and Andy make their way through the Wilson side of town...

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Aaaaaah! What was that?!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: What? What is it? What did you see?

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: I saw something moving around, creeping through the shadows!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: What did it look like?

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Like a creepy thing that creeps around, being all creepy!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Come on, Chip, you're just seeing things! This is like the time you thought there Bigfoot was in the kitchen, but it was just Aunt Mabel!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: She has `enormous` feet, okay?! No one should have feet that big!
nodes.text_bbcode: She has [color=#e23b3b][i]enormous[/i][/color] feet, okay?! No one should have feet that big!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: I hate to admit it, but Chip wasn't imagining things. There is something out there... And it's watching us.

nodes.speaker: Voice
nodes.text: doooooooooom!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: What was that?! Did you guys hear that?!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: It's a werewolf! It's a zombie! It's Aunt Mabel!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Listen to me, both of you! You cannot give in to your fears! Stay strong and brave, and we'll be fine!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: But...

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Strong and brave! Now! Do it!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: We do not fear you, understand?!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: You wanna fight? Huh? Bring it on! I'll take you down, any day!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Raaaaar! I'm tough and mean! I'm so tough, on Halloween, the Boogeyman dresses up as `me!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Raaaaar! I'm tough and mean! I'm so tough, on Halloween, the Boogeyman dresses up as [color=#e23b3b][i]me![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Heh. Good line, Chip.

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Thanks!
There's a rustling in the nearby trees...
And then it fades, leaving only the distant wail of the wind.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: We did it! Awesome job, both of you! That could've gotten real bad!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Who was that?

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Trust me on this one, Spike... You really don't want to know. Now follow me! Our destination is close!
The three of them run off...
And a ragged, pale figure emerges from the bushes...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Doom
nodes.text: not... the one... not yet...
Meanwhile, Andy leads the group down a few streets... To the Wilson High parking lot!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: The turkey's at Wilson High?

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Of course! They have one left over from their Thanksgiving lunch that they forgot to cook! It's just sitting in their cafeteria fridge!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Andy, you're a genius!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: This is where we must part ways for now... My own mission calls. Thanks for your help... And good luck saving Thanksgiving!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Waaaaaaaah! Something's gonna get us!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Stay calm, Chip! Stay c... Aaaaaagh! What was that?!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Get it together, both of you!
Suddenly, everything goes silent...

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Is... Is it gone?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Doom
nodes.text: hello... boys...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: AAAAAAAHHHH!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: AAAAAAAHHHH!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Run! Both of you! I'll hold him off!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: But... What about...

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: I'll be fine! Go! Go!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Doom
nodes.text: she will... not be... yours...

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: That is `NOT` your decision to make!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Doom
nodes.text: Doooooooom!!!
Nearby... Spike and Chip sprint through the streets... And come to the parking lot of Wilson High!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Huff... Huff... Is Pirateman going to be... Okay?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: He's a tough kid. He can take care of himself!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: But we still don't know where to go for the turkey...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: No... No, we...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Wait a minute! This is it! This is where we were supposed to go!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Wilson High?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: They always get way bigger lunches than we do! They must have leftover turkey in their cafeteria freezer!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: I don't know about this... Isn't it stealing?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: It's stealing `from Wilson`, dude! That's like killing a zombie! No judge in the land would convict you!
nodes.text_bbcode: It's stealing [color=#e23b3b][i]from Wilson[/i][/color], dude! That's like killing a zombie! No judge in the land would convict you!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Well... Okay!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Man, I haven't been here in ages! They've really touched this place up since it got flooded...

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: It got flooded?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Long story. Anyway, the cafeteria should be coming up... Right...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Here! It's just through this door!

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: What do you two think you're doing?!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Aaaaah! Who are you?
Spike lunges in front of Chip!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: She's a Wilson High student... One of the toughest!

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: Heh, that's right...

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: Now give me one good reason I shouldn't throw both of you out the nearest window!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Uh... You shouldn't do that because...

options.label: You can't take both of us!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: This is the worst Thanksgiving ever! Why did Mom have to go to her stupid work?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Hey, I'm not happy she's gone either. But you heard what she said... Marlene called in sick, and the boss said Mom had to work her shift!

nodes.text: Yeah, but... But... But... It's Thanksgiving!

nodes.text: Look, you know how hard a time Mom has had since she got laid off from her job at Prince Automotive.

nodes.text: In this economy, we should be happy she got a job at all... Even if she is a waitress at 'The Soup Shack'!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Yeah, but why does she even have to have a job? You won all that money at The FLEX-Games!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Yeah... And Mom set it aside to pay for our mortgage for the next six months!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Well, Mom is stupid! You're stupid! Soup is stupid!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Hey! You can say what you want about me, but that's no reason to insult Mom... Or soup!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Soup sucks!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Look, this situation isn't that bad! I mean...

nodes.text: Kenji steps in, carrying a small dish with some leftover mashed potatoes!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Hey man, you were there for me when I needed it today. The least I can do is give you some company!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Thanks! Why don't you go put the food out on the back deck... It's nice out there!
Kenji heads off to put his dish down.
Megan steps in holding a half-empty jar of cranberry sauce!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Hey, Spike. To be honest, I kind of feel bad for throwing all that baggage on you today. You're right... It's not your fault.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: And maybe if I'd made more of an effort to hang out with you, you would've known about Kenji and Linda. Maybe it's time I started acting like a better friend.
Megan heads off to put the jar down.
Moondog steps in holding a pumpkin pie!

nodes.speaker: Moondog
nodes.text: Dude, you found Tofurkey when she got lost! How could I `not` come over with pie?
nodes.text_bbcode: Dude, you found Tofurkey when she got lost! How could I [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] come over with pie?

nodes.speaker: Moondog
nodes.text: Plus, Patchouli refused to eat any of it, so I figured I could share it with you.
Moondog heads off to put the pie down!
Patchouli steps in holding a tray of lentil-loaf!

nodes.speaker: Patchouli
nodes.text: Hey, Spike! I figured, if you liked the lentil-loaf so much, I should bring you more, right?
Patchouli heads off to put the tray down.
Andy steps in, carrying a bag of biscuits!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: We made it into Wilson, and we made it out. If you ask me, that's a pretty good reason to celebrate!
Andy heads off to put his biscuits down.
Skazz steps in, carrying a giant tub of stuffing!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Whoa! What are `you` doing here?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Whoa! What are [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] doing here?!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Stiletto was chasing me and saying she was gonna beat me up! The only way I could lose her was by running to the Centerscore side of town!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: And once I got here, I figured, hey, I might as well stop by and see you, right? That's an okay thing to do, isn't it?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: An okay thing to do? After what you did at the FLEX-Games, I oughta beat the crap out of you!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Oh, no! Please don't do that! I didn't mean to work with Tom Prince against you! That guy is just such a smooth talker with that soothing, buttery voice!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Spike! I swear!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Well... it's Thanksgiving, and I guess I can let bygones be bygones... But why are you carrying a huge tub of stuffing?

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Huh? What stuffing?
Skazz looks down at the tub in his arms.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Whoa! Where did that come from?!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Just get inside and settle in, you big weirdo.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Yay!
Skazz rushes in to put his tub down.
Maybe you ought to think about giving thanks... For your awesome skills! You just played a perfect game!
Let's check in on some of our other characters and see how they're spending their Thanksgivings!
In Linda's room...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: It was really nice of you to have Thanksgiving dinner with my family, Howard... I hope you had fun!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Are you kidding? Last year, my Thanksgiving consisted of trying to figure out which dishes the twins had stuffed full of chili peppers!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Here's a hint: It was `all` of them!
nodes.text_bbcode: Here's a hint: It was [color=#e23b3b][i]all[/i][/color] of them!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Hee hee!
In Brendan's room...

nodes.speaker: Television
nodes.text: Yes! Pwned! That's the last of the holiday quests! Now we can all wield `Pilgrim Polearms of Pure Power!` They've got +9 against turkeys!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yes! Pwned! That's the last of the holiday quests! Now we can all wield [i]Pilgrim Polearms of Pure Power![/i] They've got +9 against turkeys!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yeah... I guess that's cool...

nodes.speaker: Television
nodes.text: What's wrong, Brendizzle? You haven't been yourself the last couple of days. Don't you like polearms?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: It's nothing. Never mind. Woo hoo polearms, am I right?
And on stage at the Centerscore Society For Exceptionally Dark Poetry...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Like a hat without a buckle...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Like a rock not named Plymouth...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Like some tin-foil wrapped turkey on December 1st...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I am... Alone.
And at 'The Oceanside Obelisk', favorite restaurant of Tom Prince and his father Silas...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Ahem. Could you pass the salt? My quail liver is a bit bland...

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: Oh! I must not have been reading the news today! Did the Feds finally crack down and close Prince Enterprises?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: What? Of course not!

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: So I'm still the CEO of a massive, multibillion dollar business empire?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Of course you are!

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: Then why are you treating me like a waiter, boy?! Get your own salt!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Yes, sir...
And that's all we've got for Thanksgiving! Some good times, some bad times, and some... Well, some Tom Prince times!
See you next time!
Megan steps in holding a half-empty jar of cranberry sauce!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: To be honest, I kind of feel bad for throwing all that baggage on you today. You're right... It's not your fault.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: And maybe if I'd made more of an effort to hang out with you, you would've known about Kenji and Linda. Maybe it's time I started acting like a better friend.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Don't worry about it... I'm just happy to see you! You can put your food down on the back deck... It's nice out!
Megan heads off to put the jar down.
Moondog steps in holding a pumpkin pie!

nodes.speaker: Moondog
nodes.text: Spike, man, you found Tofurkey when she got lost! That means you deserve one heck of a pumpkin pie!
Moondog heads off to put the pie down!
